text:
Nina: FYI - Meridian Express is exploring voice-to-summary workflows for their customer support team. They're planning to spin up 2 new squads (CS triage + quality), estimate ~200 reqs/min steady, 500 reqs/min peaks for 30-45min windows. They're asking if we can support streaming voice inputs + low-latency summaries, and whether Dedicated would be necessary. Renewal in 10 weeks.
Priya: Do they have sample audio sizes or token approximations?
Nina: They shared an average transcript length ~250 tokens, summary ~100 tokens. Using 300 reqs/min -> ~105k tokens/min -> ~151M tokens/day. Two-region plan (NA + APAC) later.
Omar: Streaming voice will affect CPU/socket time. For Dedicated I'd recommend 2 reserved nodes with optimized streaming config, autoscale to 5 for peaks. Consider prefix caching for repeated prompts and a batching window tuned for latency.
Tess: Enablement asks: demo for streaming SDK, compliance checklist, and a test harness for their QA team. I'll prepare a 60min demo + a test checklist.
deploy-bot: capacity-scan: hosted_quota=3M tokens/day, reserved_capacity=0, recent_peak=1.2M tokens/day
Priya: That token projection is far above hosted quotas. We need to propose Dedicated or Private. Also flag renewal risk if we can't commit to low-latency streaming.
Nina: Scheduling: I'm available Mon 9-10 PT for an architecture sync. QA asked for p95 latency targets.
Omar: I'll draft an initial sizing doc and estimate costs; will include variants: Dedicated streaming-optimized vs Private with edge transcoders.
Priya: Action items: 1) Nina schedule tech sync with AE, 2) Omar sizing + cost variants, 3) Tess draft demo & test harness, 4) Infra confirm APAC region feasibility.
Tess: I'll add a short survey to capture depot network characteristics.
Nina: Thanks team - trying to ensure we have a clear Dedicated path before renewal. :eyes:
